# Every workflow

78 ways to start: 70 workflows and 8 step by step. This page lists each one: what it does, where to open it, the models it offers and where they run, what it takes, the ComfyUI graph behind it and where that graph comes from.

Read it like this:

- **Open** is the link inside the app (add it after your app’s address). Nothing runs until you press Generate.
- **Models**: each model with the places it runs. **Your computer** is free (the size is the model files it downloads once). **Comfy Cloud** runs it through your Comfy key at the price shown; “priced before you run” means the app shows the exact price on the button first. Other providers (fal, Replicate, a lab’s own API) are listed only where they add something.
- **Files in** and **Settings** are the fields of the tool that runs it (some tools serve several workflows, so not every field shows for every workflow).
- **ComfyUI graph** links the graph file in [`workflows/`](../workflows/) with the licences of what it loads ([workflows/LICENSES.md](../workflows/LICENSES.md)). **Comes from** credits the official Comfy template or community workflow it follows.
- **Custom nodes (local)** are the node packs a local run needs besides ComfyUI itself; the app installs them for you (see [Local models and hardware](LOCAL-MODELS-AND-HARDWARE.md)).

Model licences and credit lines: [LICENSES.md](../LICENSES.md) and [Attribution](ATTRIBUTION.md).

## Step by step

Chains of the workflows above, one step after another. Each step shows its price before you run it.

<a id="chain-presenter"></a>
### A talking presenter

Your own presenter, reading your script.

| | |
|---|---|
| Steps | 1. Make a portrait, add your logo: [Create Image](#i-create-image) · GPT Image 2.5 Flare<br>2. Read your script aloud: [Voiceover](#a-voiceover) · Qwen3 TTS 1.7B<br>3. Make the portrait say it: [Make a photo talk](#v-lip-sync) · InfiniteTalk (Wan 2.1) |
| Hand-off | On the voice, press Make it talk, then add the portrait. |

<a id="chain-sketch-film"></a>
### Sketch → Film

Block it in 3D, then film that shot.

| | |
|---|---|
| Steps | 1. Stage the scene and the camera, record a free mockup: [Plan a shot in 3D](#v-direct-a-shot) · In your browser<br>2. Paint the mockup’s first frame into a photo: [Create Image](#i-create-image) · GPT Image 2.5 Flare<br>3. Render the film: LTX-2.5 follows the mockup: [Plan a shot in 3D](#v-direct-a-shot) · LTX-2.5 + Layout to Render |
| Hand-off | Stage and render on the Direct a Shot page. We painted our first frame in Create Image; the page can paint one for you, free on your computer, or you can skip it. |
| Agent skill | [direct-a-shot](../skills/direct-a-shot/SKILL.md) |
| Example | [ltx-mockup-film.mp4](../web/public/showcase/ltx-mockup-film.mp4) |

<a id="chain-kdrama"></a>
### Film a scene from a script

Paste a script, get a voiced scene.

| | |
|---|---|
| Steps | 1. Paste the script, get the scene, voiced: [Create Video](#v-create) · MiniMax H3 |
| Hand-off | Our scene is one 15-second take. Press Extend on it to keep it going. |
| Agent skill | [drama-series](../skills/drama-series/SKILL.md) |
| Example | [h3-kdrama-script.mp4](../web/public/showcase/h3-kdrama-script.mp4) |

<a id="chain-long-take"></a>
### One long take

One clip, kept going past 20 seconds.

| | |
|---|---|
| Steps | 1. Make the opening shot: [Create Video](#v-create) · MiniMax H3<br>2. Continue the same action and camera: [Make a clip longer](#v-extend) · H3 Extend |
| Hand-off | On a video result, Extend picks it up; “Continue from last frame” starts a new clip from its last frame. |
| Example | [h3-koi-take.mp4](../web/public/showcase/h3-koi-take.mp4) |

<a id="chain-product-ad"></a>
### Product photo → ad

A product shot, then a presenter ad.

| | |
|---|---|
| Steps | 1. Make the product shot: [Product Shot](#i-product-shot)<br>2. Spin the camera around it: [Orbit Shot](#v-orbit-shot)<br>3. A phone-style ad with a presenter: [UGC Ad](#v-ugc-ad) |
| Hand-off | On the product shot, “Turn to video” starts the next step; each step shows its price before you run it. |
| Agent skill | [ugc-ad](../skills/ugc-ad/SKILL.md) |

<a id="chain-product-ad-multishot"></a>
### Product ad in shots

Up to three photos, one ad in shots.

| | |
|---|---|
| Steps | 1. Make the hero shot: the product in its scene (Image 1): [Product Shot](#i-product-shot)<br>2. Reference to video: hero shot plus two detail photos, the shots written with their times: [Create Video](#v-create) · MiniMax H3 |
| Hand-off | Write the shots with their times in one prompt, like “0–3 s: slow push-in on the bottle. 3–6 s: macro on the cap.” Image 1 sets the scene for every shot; Images 2 and 3 show product details. |
| Comes from | [Product Advertisement Video (official Comfy template)](https://comfy.org/workflows/c98e5c457e1e-c98e5c457e1e/) by Rob (as published on comfy.org/workflows (no licence stated on the page)) |

<a id="chain-music-video"></a>
### Song → music video

Make a track, then clips on its beats.

| | |
|---|---|
| Steps | 1. Make the song: [Make music](#a-music) · YuE2<br>2. One clip per beat: [Create Video](#v-create) · LTX-2.5 22B |
| Hand-off | The music-video skill lets your AI agent plan the beats and stitch the clips. Have a clip already? “Music for a video” scores it instead. |
| Agent skill | [music-video](../skills/music-video/SKILL.md) |

<a id="chain-picture-3d"></a>
### Picture → 3D → spin

A picture into 3D, then a spinning video.

| | |
|---|---|
| Steps | 1. Make or pick the picture: [Create Image](#i-create-image) · GPT Image 2.5 Flare<br>2. Turn it into a textured model: [Image to 3D](#d-image-to-3d) · Tripo 3.1<br>3. Record it spinning, free in your browser: [Turntable video](#d-turntable) |
| Hand-off | On an image result, “Send to 3D” fills the slot; a 3D result’s “Make a video” records the turntable. |
